featured_reviews.name: Naresh Shirodkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Walking into this bakery always feels comforting—familiar aromas, shelves full of freshly baked goodness, and the assurance that you’ll walk out with something you’ll genuinely enjoy. Theobroma Bakery has built that kind of trust over time, especially for those who value quality over gimmicks.

Their fresh sourdough and artisanal breads are absolute standouts and personal favourites—beautifully crusted, well-fermented, and full of character. The quiches and tarts are consistently satisfying, with buttery bases and well-balanced fillings that make them reliable picks every time. The tea cakes are another strong point: soft, moist, and understated, making them perfect companions to coffee or tea.

The pastry and cake counter is equally impressive, offering a wide range of flavours—from indulgent chocolate classics to lighter, nuanced options. Each dessert feels thoughtfully made, never overly sweet, and always well-executed. What’s equally commendable is the good balance of savoury items, which adds depth to the menu and keeps things interesting beyond desserts.

It’s the kind of place you return to not just for cravings, but for consistency, comfort, and the quiet joy of well-made food.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Sarah is an amazing master baker! Love & flour have some of the richest flavours and finest cakes you can get in Mumbai.

We ordered a chocolate buttercream cake for our daughter's birthday. The cake within minutes of cutting was all gobbled down.

Our party was hosted on a yacht and for that reason we requested premium packaging for which we are so thankful to Sarah for her attention to detail in making, packing and delivering the cake.

The cake remained immaculate in its packaging until it was time to cut it even after 2 hrs of delivery.

Sarah's customer skills are of the highest standard and simply extraordinary.

We believe a picture speaks thousand words hence sharing the actual pictures with you.

Thank you Love & Flour for making a cake that will forever be a cherished highlight of our daughter's 5th birthday.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Breakfast at Flurys Tearoom, Colaba – A Sweet Start to the Day!

Went here with my family for breakfast and it turned out to be such a good start to the day!

Food – Fresh ingredients, cooked just right (nothing under or over), and nicely plated. We didn’t have to send anything back, which says a lot. Their pâtisserie spread? Absolute treat.

Service – The staff was friendly, attentive, and professional. Loved how the chef took time to understand our allergies and suggest great customisations. Service was quick, no long waits.

Ambience – Cute, cozy, and warm vibe. Clean overall, though a couple of flies showed up (the staff handled it fast). Decor gives you that nice tearoom feel.

Surprisingly impressive! Clean, well-stocked (health faucet ✅, toilet roll ✅, hand wash ✅), and not smelly. Honestly, so many places miss this detail – but Flurys gets it right.

Kid-Friendly – Kids will absolutely love it here. The menu + pâtisserie are totally child-approved.

Price – Portions are fair, usually one dish per person. Around ₹ 1200/head – I personally found it slightly expensive but worth it for the quality.

🌟 Verdict – A cool breakfast spot with flavourful savouries, indulgent desserts, and a lovely family vibe. Definitely worth checking out when in Colaba.

Having tried the other samples and given her pleasing demeanour, would highly recommend her services.

She does a variety of cakes and desserts and comes up with very unique gifting solutions for all occasions - I have in the past dealt with her for diwali gifting as well. Definitely relying on her for a lot of our future requirements too!!

Do try out her cakes, bakes, sweets and treats!!
